hai_21.03.note: HAI partitions are provided as binary attack/no-attack windows without a stable per-scenario technique label. The default technique is assigned conservatively to the ICS telemetry spoofing family for evaluation continuity.

cic_modbus_2023.note: CIC Modbus captures are labeled at the capture level; without raw attack-origin metadata, the evaluation assigns the default Modbus manipulation technique to all observed attack windows.
